angularDiameterSource: Derived from the published radius and inverse-parallax distance; not a resolved angular-diameter measurement.
distanceSource: SIMBAD Gaia EDR3 parallax 31.0369 +/- 0.0222 mas; inverse parallax, without zero-point correction.
radiusSource: Luque et al. (2023), Nature 623, 932–937, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06692-3, Extended Data Table 3: radius 0.788 +/- 0.008 solar radii, mass 0.798 +/- 0.042 solar masses, effective temperature 5266 +/- 64 K. Conversion uses 695700 km per solar radius and solar GM 132712440041.93938 km^3/s^2. The display axis is sky north, not a measured stellar pole.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Luque et al. (2023), Nature 623, 932–937, Extended Data Table 3: 5266 +/- 64 K; https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06692-3

shape.qualification: Spherical unresolved stellar disc at the published radius. Its uniform chromaticity comes from the archived ESPRESSO spectrum; brightness, spots and limb darkening are not measured by this rendering.
